description: Defines the implementation of the pdcp_entity class, including its constructor, destructor, and interface methods, as well as private members for managing PDCP entity components such as tx, rx, timers, and metrics.

classes.name: pdcp_entity_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the pdcp_entity interface, managing PDCP protocol data unit processing, timers, and inter-component communication.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing PDCP entity with configuration, notifiers, timers, and executors.

methods.name: ~pdcp_entity_impl
methods.description: Destructor that stops the PDCP entity.

methods.name: get_tx_upper_control_interface
methods.description: Returns the upper control interface for transmission.

methods.name: get_tx_upper_data_interface
methods.description: Returns the upper data interface for transmission.

methods.name: get_tx_lower_interface
methods.description: Returns the lower interface for transmission.

methods.name: get_rx_upper_control_interface
methods.description: Returns the upper control interface for reception.

methods.name: get_rx_lower_interface
methods.description: Returns the lower interface for reception.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the PDCP entity, timers, and components.

methods.name: tx_crypto_awaitable
methods.description: Returns the event flag for transmission crypto operations.

methods.name: rx_crypto_awaitable
methods.description: Returns the event flag for reception crypto operations.
